$comment: Uncached `test` task seconds per Nx project for the CI test-shard dealer (scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts). Source: the uncached `test` tasks of the 216 sampled affected-lane jobs of green merge-group runs of ci.yml, 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-17, on hosted ubuntu runners at --parallel=1 (tau-brain research/artifacts/ci-throughput-review/runs/2026-11-17-cloud/mq/structural/cache-tasks-sample.tsv); a task's seconds are the gap from the previous task header in the job log, and each value is the median of its samples (the 2026-11-09 era-D snapshot had cli at 854 s; it now takes about 104 s). A project not listed weighs defaultSeconds, the median sampled project. The `revisions:test:shard-<k>` units are the three parts of the revisions suite (410 s uncached; packages/revisions/test-shards.test-utils.ts balances them by test-shards.test.seconds.json), each about a third of it plus Vitest's start. Refresh when a listed project's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
